mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.alert_id AS alertId, r.rule_id AS ruleId, r.event_type AS eventType, r.level AS level, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.target_name AS targetName, r.project_id AS projectId, r.cluster_id AS clusterId, r.content AS content, r.channels AS channels, r.deliver_result AS deliverResult, r.result AS result, r.fired_at AS firedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM alert_record r WHERE r.event_type = #{eventType} AND r.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.fired_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS id, r.alert_id AS alertId, r.rule_id AS ruleId, r.event_type AS eventType, r.level AS level, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.target_name AS targetName, r.project_id AS projectId, r.cluster_id AS clusterId, r.content AS content, r.channels AS channels, r.deliver_result AS deliverResult, r.result AS result, r.fired_at AS firedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM alert_record r WHERE (#{eventType} IS NULL OR r.event_type = #{eventType}) AND (#{from} IS NULL OR r.fired_at >= #{from}) AND (#{to} IS NULL OR r.fired_at <= #{to}) ORDER BY r.fired_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM alert_record r WHERE (#{eventType} IS NULL OR r.event_type = #{eventType}) AND (#{from} IS NULL OR r.fired_at >= #{from}) AND (#{to} IS NULL OR r.fired_at <= #{to})
